name: spec
title: Column specification of a data frame

origin.description: The specification is stored on the data frame returned by a reader.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The specification is stored on the data frame returned by a reader.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- spec(read_csv(I("a,b\n1,x")))
paste(vapply(parsed$cols, function(col) class(col)[1], ""), collapse = ",")

translation.description: The specification is stored on the data frame returned by a reader.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: The specification is stored on the data frame returned by a reader.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
parsed = spec(read_csv(I("a,b\n1,x"), show_col_types=False))
return ",".join("collector_" + collector.kind for collector in parsed.cols)
